gizmo.title: Wurin jefa hoto
gizmo.description: Masu koyo suna sanya lakabi a kan yankunan da aka shimfiɗa a kan hoto, sannan su duba amsarsu.

configure.title: Hoto
configure.description: Hoton da masu koyo ke sanya lakabi a kai.

configure.title: Madadin rubutu
configure.description: Yana bayyana hoton don mutanen da ba sa iya ganinsa. Kada ka bayyana inda lakabin ke zuwa.

configure.title: Taken hoto
configure.description: Gajeren take da ake gani don hoton, ana nuna shi a samansa.

configure.title: Tambaya
configure.description: Abin da ake tambayar masu koyo su yi da lakabin.

configure.title: Lakabi da yankuna
configure.description: Kowane abu lakabi ne da masu koyo za su iya sanyawa. Ba lakabi sunan yanki don sanya yankinsa a kan hoton; lakabi ba tare da sunan yanki ba ƙari ne da ba shi da wuri. Lambobin yanki kashi ne na hoton.

configure.title: Taken hoto
configure.description: Taken zaɓi da ake nunawa ƙarƙashin hoton.

advanced.title: Ƙoƙari
advanced.description: Sau nawa mai koyo zai iya dubawa. 0 yana nufin mara iyaka.

advanced.title: Gauraya lakabi
advanced.description: Nuna lakabin a tsari daban kowace ziyara.

advanced.title: Ana iya naɗewa
advanced.description: Nuna wannan tambaya a matsayin layi da ke buɗewa da rufewa. Buɗe ɗaya yana rufe sauran tambayoyin da ake iya naɗewa da ke kusa da shi.

advanced.title: Fara a naɗe
advanced.description: Idan ana iya naɗewa, fara a matsayin layi a rufe da ke nuna tambayar da matsayinta kawai.

advanced.title: Tsarin bayar da maki
advanced.description: OER Schema: tsarin bayar da maki don wannan kimantawa (misali maki, harafi, kashi, kammalawa).

advanced.title: Manufar koyo
advanced.description: OER Schema: manufar koyo da ke da alaƙa da wannan kimantawa.

developer.title: Sunan tambayoyin
developer.description: Sunan tambayoyin da ake amfani da shi don gano xAPI a tsarin nazari.

developer.title: Kwas
developer.description: OER Schema: kwas ɗin da aka yi wannan kimantawa domin shi.
